tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a Google Cloud workload for a customer in us-central1 (Iowa) — set up a quote for Compute Engine (n2-standard-4), override the default usage to 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) for the month, and pin the Standard tier since this is a regulated tenant.
